description.narrative: GS 25 Ltd. Liability Co.s (GS25 VN or the Company) is one of the largest convenience store chain operators in Vietnam. IFCs proposed investment will support GS25 VNs expansion of its GS25 convenience store chain network in Vietnam (the Project).

The most significant, expected Project-level outcomes are increased access to modern retail for consumers, with improved product variety and services. By expanding its retail network, the Company will offer a more diverse selection of safe food and beverage products to a growing number of Vietnamese consumers. As a modern retailer, the Company will be able to ensure that products are sourced from trusted brands and suppliers. The Companys expansion will provide local producers and importers with additional sales channels as well as help improve efficiency and operating standards up and down the supply chain through its requirements. With the planned new store openings, the Project is expected to generate a high number of jobs for employees in the stores, as well as indirect jobs for supply chain, logistics support and administration. Beyond The Project, IFC anticipates that the investment will promote competitiveness through the adoption of a cost-efficient, innovative business model enabling an ambitious expansion plan and generate competitive pressures on other modern retailers to increase their presence in areas where modern grocery retail penetration is low.
